chapter: Gillespie and Carter on John Collins
title: Goodbyes and archive plans for the transcripts
summary: Willard explains the tapes will be kept at the Smithsonian with transcripts available on request, and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Okay, well I thank you very much.
Wonderful. Will I be able to see this when it comes out?

They're going to keep the tapes in the archives at the Smithsonian and then they're going to do a transcription of it which as I understand it, it will be available to people requesting it. I think that's the way it's going to be.
Let me know when it's available and I will forward a request.
And I'll have those records for you.
Fine, thank you very much, Benny.
